initial_decision.brief_rationale: The observed risk difference is 0.1 minus 0.5 = -0.4. The verification checks establish arithmetic accuracy but provide no causal identification. Request archived design record R290-2 to assess whether the causal effect is identified.

final_decision.brief_rationale: Lottery assignment independently of both potential outcomes, full compliance, positivity, consistency, and no interference identify the causal effect. The exact population risks are 1/10 under X=1 and 20/40 under X=0, giving 0.1 − 0.5 = −0.4.
